summary: Frontend-only verification of Meals 'Purchases & Issues' page changes: default 'Daily entry' tab, category header qty+amount subtotals for Purchases/Issues/Wastage, and 1-decimal quantity formatting across meal screens. All targeted changes verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: MealEntryTab.jsx is 1200+ lines — consider splitting (row renderer, save chain hook, keyboard nav hook) for maintainability. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Entered small test purchases/issues/wastage on Apple + Banana (Fruits) on 2026-09-11 via auto-save; can be cleared by resetting those rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) /admin/meals-report opens with 'Daily entry' as default active tab (meals-report-tab-entry has border-blue-600) and is FIRST in tab bar. URL is clean (no ?tab=) when on entry. (2) Category header row exposes new data-testids entry-cat-{purch|issue|wastage}-{qty|total}-{catKey}; all 6 found for Fruits. With Apple qty=2.55/rate=12 + issue 1.33 + wastage 0.5, and Banana qty=1.5/rate=10, the Fruits header displayed: purch-qty '4.1', purch-total '₹45.60', issue-qty '1.3', issue-total '₹129.74', wastage-qty '0.5', wastage-total '₹48.77' — all correctly summed and qty is 1 decimal, amounts 2 decimals. (3) On-hand column sampled 15 non-empty values, zero contained 3-decimal quantities (e.g. 16.5, 21.2, 12.1, 12.6, 1.6, -0.2). (4) Stock Master + Expense report tabs scanned for \d+\.\d{3} patterns — none found. (5) Day nav + Day total cards render (₹45.60 / ₹129.74 / ₹48.77) and auto-save fires (Saved indicator shown). Minor test-script flake: clicking meals-report-tab-entry AFTER navigating to expenses didn't consistently re-render the grid within the wait window — likely sticky-header overlay/timing on the automation; screenshots show tab bar and tabs work individually. Not a product bug (initial default tab load works).
